name: Spore Spot
source:
After dying in a forest, your afterlife begins with you exploring the forest in your new mushroom body. You meet others who share the same fate. Unsurprisingly, they all have their own underlying issues they have yet to address. Can you be the one to help them through such a scary subject?

[From [url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/spore-spot]itch.io[/url]]
